extraction.topic: GOAL_ALFRED.md A-0802 (Widerspruch/CONFLICT): real cross-document requirement-ID collision on G-0006
extraction.notes: This extraction deliberately ingests both claims NEUTRALLY (epistemic_kind=CLAIM, verification_status=UNVERIFIED, no claim_relations) -- per maintainer correction, 'same ID exists twice' is not itself sufficient grounds to declare CONFLICT (that would flag every harmless ID duplication as a conflict). CONFLICT is a CONCLUSION tools/claim-db/detect_conflicts.py must derive by checking all four conditions: same external ID (claim_targets.symbol), different source, different semantic assertion (normalized_claim text differs), both claims currently active, and no existing SUPERSEDES/DUPLICATES relation between them. Only then does the detector itself set epistemic_kind=CONFLICT/verification_status=CONTRADICTED and record the CONTRADICTS relation with its reasoning -- see tools/test-claim-conflict.mjs.
